title: Small fan-in-two circuit representation
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every Boolean function $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$, there is a well-formed acyclic Boolean circuit with at most two inputs to each gate that computes $f$ and has size at most $40\cdot 2^n/(n+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on $n$ input bits
